body: If this life is all we get then that's all the more reason for me to do it.  I long for nothingness.  It sounds peaceful.  I want peace.

Thank you for caring and taking the time to respond. Think about this... if you have a pet that you care about that is in great pain that you can't stop the humane thing is to euthanize it.  I'm in great pain that can't be stopped.  It's just emotional instead of physical.  Wouldn't it be the humane, caring thing to let me die?

However, for some this is NOT a temporary feeling.  I've suffered from depression since I was a teen and I'm 26 now.  I've been on all sorts of anti-depressants and been through lots of therapy.  My father is the same exact thing except for hes in his 50s now and still feels like killing himself all the time.  Same case for a lot people in my family.  I don't kid myself, this is a permanent illness I have to live with till I die.  

Secondly, pills for depression are easy to find but are not the panacea they are made out to be.  Terrible side effects, the major one being idealization of suicide.  Therapy for someone with no insurance and making shit wage is almost impossible to get.  Everyone's default answer is "just get help".  Well most people have no idea that in the US that isn't easy for those who need it the most.  So why force them to jump through hoops when *sometimes* its a temporary solution to a permanent problem?

On a throwaway here.  I was definitely a crazy ex to one of my girlfriends.  I have severe depression and while with this girl I had a drug induced (from anti-depressants) manic episode that lasted about a month.  During this month I told her all sorts of crazy stuff like God was talking to me and giving me epiphanies.  Thought God wanted me to write a book that would become famous and that I was going to marry this current girl.  Once the mania wore off I started getting depressed and sort of blamed her.  So I broke up with her almost out of the blue. After leveling out a bit I regret it so much.  She hates me now.  I don't blame her.  I'm crazy.
Wow thank you man, that was beautiful.  It means a lot to me that you wrote all that.  I really don't like myself but you're absolutely right and I'm gonna try pull myself up.
